    Brett Lauderdale To Address GCW Title Situation At GCW Fight Club

    Jeremy LambertOctober 7, 2026, 5:26 pm
    Facebook X Bluesky

    The GCW World Title situation involving Joseph Sawyer will get some clarity.

    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 0:50
    Instaread

    Game Changer Wrestling announced that GCW promoter Brett Lauderdale will address the status of the World Title at GCW Fight Club on Sunday, October 11.

    Joseph Sawyer is the reigning GCW Champion, but has missed recent GCW shows, including their event in Alaska.

    At GCW Score on September 26, Joseph Sawyer walked out on his GCW Title defense against John Jeffrey after suffering an apparent knee injury. In the moment, an upset Sawyer stated that he thought he would be out for months. He later said he would be okay and has upcoming bookings, including TNA Bound For Glory on Sunday.

    Former champion Atticus Cogar called out Sawyer for missing events. You can find his comments here. 

    Fightful will have coverage of Fight Club on Sunday.
